subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that is related to the third term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term.

NEWTON ∶ OPUXFO ∶∶ ZYGOTE ∶ ?
solution:
The position of letters according to the English alphabet series:

 [IMAGE: https://lh4.googleusercontent.com/yGFfAJ0yq-odijoHcC5rgdLzoluzu-b1kh8Ul6DD0uNFFwej--XqOn_yX-Zcl0SAJeZlxYDs2U1bZKJIayoNzmvm1C94uOwE4IZlSWQk6GKztSwZtg5hBJ-l4OXzmt1G-N1fyeJaFiHki2TBZWW_Dg] 

NEWTON : OPUXFO

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3fbd45f3e50f06d4fa227fcb8a64d462be629a86b686501af3e8dc51f3be018d.png] 

Similarly,

ZYGOTE : FUPHZA

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/038a64685cb5b1ac817d293cb15804cd70d49d862d0960266e9ff3676f0ee298.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "FUPHZA".
